title: NotesGet
description: Result of the notes.get JSON-RPC method: one note, whole. This is what the editor opens with.

body.description: The note, markdown, exactly as it was written.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds. An edit never moves it.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last edit.

title.description: DERIVED from the body's first non-empty line, every time it is read — never stored (design §7). Empty when the body has nothing to name it by; the surface names that one with its creation date, which needs a locale the backend does not have. It travels with the note so the tab's title has ONE owner: a renderer deriving its own would be the second.
